description: DOL's processing times (average days, and the month each queue is working on when DOL prints one), the filing month DOL is deciding by PERM Tracker's daily check of case statuses (perm.decidingNow: DOL stopped printing a PERM month on Oct 31 2026), the oldest month still open, and the pending PERM cases by filing month. Example: {}.
name: get_queue

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: DOL's processing times and the pending PERM queue by filing month.

inAnalystReview.description: How many of the pending are in analyst review.

pendingPermByFilingMonth.description: Pending PERM cases by filing month. Null when the count can't be read, never an empty list.

asOf.description: The day DOL's PERM processing times are dated.

averageDays.description: DOL's average days to a decision, by kind of determination.

calendarDays.description: Average calendar days to a decision.

determination.description: The kind of determination, e.g. Analyst Review.

month.description: The month the average is for, when DOL gives one. Null when DOL gives a period.

period.description: The period the average covers, as DOL names it, e.g. Last 30 Days.

asOf.description: The day that reading was taken.

month.description: The filing month DOL is deciding, as YYYY-MM.

decidingNow.description: The filing month DOL is deciding now, by PERM Tracker's daily check of case statuses. Null when it can't be read.

oldestOpenMonth.description: The oldest filing month that still has pending cases, as YYYY-MM.

queues.description: The months DOL printed for its PERM queues. Empty since October 31, 2026, when DOL stopped printing a PERM month: decidingNow gives the month by our own check.

items.description: One queue as DOL's processing times page printed it.

asPrinted.description: The same month in the words DOL printed.

queue.description: The queue's name as DOL printed it, e.g. Analyst Review.

workingOnMonth.description: The filing month DOL printed for the queue, as YYYY-MM.

asOf.description: The day DOL's prevailing wage processing times are dated.

receiptMonth.description: The month the requests were received, as YYYY-MM.

remainingRequests.description: PERM wage requests from that month still pending.

permRequestsPending.description: Prevailing wage requests for PERM still pending, by the month DOL received them. Null when DOL's page can't be read.

queues.description: The receipt month DOL prints for each prevailing wage queue.

nonOewsReceiptDate.description: The same for requests using another wage source.

oewsReceiptDate.description: The receipt month DOL is working on for requests using its OEWS wage survey, as YYYY-MM.

program.description: The program the wage request is for, e.g. PERM, H-1B or CW-1.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Get processing times and the pending queue
